title: Regenerate features, fit the head and evaluate candidate promotion
description:
## Behavior and acceptance
Run the main decision plus element tasks through the adapter; map real answer probabilities to named numerical features. On task changes regenerate missing/stale training and development features with complete fingerprints. Fit only trusted full-coverage labels with recorded propensity weighting; calibrate out of fold. Compare incumbent/candidate on the same development records with a preregistered rule, retain or promote a complete versioned bundle, and reload predictions identically. Never fit or select on audit/scoreboard.
Scenario: a changed task triggers feature regeneration and refitting; failed/incomplete candidate leaves incumbent active; optimizer cannot supply weights.

## Constraints
Native provider-neutral library only; no DSPy. The application does not implement a second flywheel. Optimizer proposes; code validates/applies; numerical fitting alone sets weights and calibration. Training, development, random audit and sealed scoreboard remain separated. No credentials or private article text in committed artifacts. Specs first with fake clients; live calls explicit and budgeted.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Core integration now implemented in flywheel.py: validated structural proposals -> full probability features -> existing trusted propensity-weighted fit_learned_head with OOF calibration -> same-development Brier comparison -> durable promotion/rejection. SQLite persists active config/head, private events, complete-answer caches, and completed/pending round guards. Fake-client specs cover promotion, restored serving, corrected-label invalidation, protected splits and missing propensity refusal. This is offline evidence, not live demo completion. Reviewer client/CLI wiring and bounded live verification remain.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented label-independent balanced evaluation: per-class recall/count/Brier and descriptive Wilson recall intervals; natural and equal-class summaries on identical fixed dev records; promotion defaults to balanced Brier. Missing/under-minimum class coverage waits before paid optimizer calls (reviewer floor two dev examples per class). Optional equal-class training combines inverse review propensities with equal total class influence; recomputed independently per OOF fit, natural OOF calibration weights retained. Policies included in round cache keys and training provenance. CLI and make expose separate evaluation/training policies. Synthetic multi-class/imbalance/missing-class/OOF/UI/cache specs cover the new behavior; no new live calls or rating mutations.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implementing native isolated-control scheduler after user identified optional/bundled feature discovery as misalignment. Three explicit discovery calls, one each for rubric/example_ids/tasks; strict single-control schema. Every candidate is fit/tested against the same frozen incumbent and identical balanced development items; only best qualifying candidate promoted afterward. Persistent idea/cycle tables retain failures, include historical bundled ideas without falsely labeling their old outcomes as isolated tests, avoid unchanged-feedback discovery, and reserve periodic retry priority for overdue ideas. Reviewer delegates to this core scheduling path and shows control-level events. Bounded frozen-data live experiment preflight:227-request upper bound,3 optimizer calls, equal-class head fitting fixed across all three comparisons; private fresh runtime, live labels untouched.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Completed real isolated-control experiment on frozen 87-vote snapshot. Three separate GPT-6 Luna discoveries and ML fits share one empty incumbent. Actual usage: 219 Jev calls, 3 optimizer calls. Development Brier: baseline 0.5795; rubric 0.9327; examples 0.3920; supporting questions 0.9169. Examples-only promoted inside separate experiment runtime. Independent balanced audit improved 2/4 to 4/4; sample too small for a general accuracy claim. All ideas retained. Scheduler periodically revisits older ideas with changed feedback, preserves completed controls across interrupted restarts, and never repeats unchanged completed evidence. Offline suite: 417 passed. Combination trials remain deferred. Reviewer requires restart to use updated scheduler; no live database or active live classifier was replaced.
